pages.text: Returns the day of the month (1 to 31).$(br2)Without $(1)time$() the function uses the current time. It uses the time zone of the server.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the day, 1 to 31
$(1)CALL c0de/time/DAY$(br)  PARAMETER time birthday ;$(br)  RESULT result day$()
